description: Arena Flag Bug Match. WHEN: a finished match was hit by a bug (tester or player). Flags that match from your own history (past matches too) for review. Flagging alone never changes your record; only an arena reviewer confirmation removes a confirmed bug loss. Then a reviewer calls arena_confirm_bug_loss. Example: arena_flag_bug_match {"match_id":"<match_id>","reason":"<reason>"}

key.description: Your ark_ arena key (or send Authorization: Bearer).

match_id.description: Finished match id from your history (arena_get_replay / receipts).

name: arena_flag_bug_match
